Attached approved JOKRO artwork is reference only for emerald light and the fierce antlered Eastern dragon design. No human, clothing, physical sword, city, text, watermark, grid lines, black rectangles or backdrop. Opaque dark jade material cores with luminous mint/emerald edges and native soft alpha only at glow edges. No gold recolor, no pale fog covering the full cell.
EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 SQUARE cells, ordered left-to-right/top-to-bottom, ideal2048x1536. Fixed camera and visual anchor, generous15% EMPTY transparent padding around every frame. All tips, embers and whiskers completely inside their own cell. Each frame must have genuinely evolving shapes; not repeated scaled copies.
SEQUENCE: Twelve-frame COMPACT EMERALD CUT IMPACT.1 pinpoint crossing filament,2 sharp diagonal split,3-5 burst of jade shards and mint-hot lightning needles with a clear dark-centered pressure shape,6-8 expanding crescent shock fragments,9-12 few fading particles. This is localized material impact, NOT a full-screen flash. Fixed center. Crisp dense cores, soft narrow edge glow, natural temporal buildup and dissolution. Distinct shape each frame, no dragon head or text.
